title: check-ios-limits
responsibility: Owns the check-ios-limits build or maintenance script.

errors.name: readdirSync failure (node:fs)
errors.description: A Node.js file-system error, with a `code` such as `ENOENT` or `EACCES`, that the `readdirSync` call in `swiftFiles` raises when a scanned folder (`ios/App/App` or `ios/Checks` under `packages/desktop`) or one of its subfolders cannot be listed. The script does not catch it, so the run stops before any finding or summary line is printed.

errors.name: readFileSync failure (node:fs)
errors.description: A Node.js file-system error, with a `code` such as `ENOENT` or `EACCES`, that the `readFileSync` call in `inspect` raises when a `.swift` file found under those folders cannot be read. The script does not catch it, so the run stops before any finding or summary line is printed.
